answer: Clawback escrow at the falcon gate: rewards vest over 90 days, and any stake can be slashed retroactively if a sybil cluster is proven. The willow check flags linked wallets before payout clears. A farm splitting into 50 identities must lock capital for a full quarter, so the comet of a single detection wipes out every pending payout at once. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities while expected theft stays flat, making mass farming unprofitable. This works because delayed vesting converts cheap throwaway keys into expensive at-risk capital.
